HomePage.benefitsTitle: More reasons to become a member
HomePage.benefit1Desc: Enjoy on Smart TVs, PlayStation, Xbox, Chromecast, Apple TV, and more.
HomePage.benefit2Desc: Save your favorites easily and always have something to watch.
HomePage.benefit3Desc: Stream instantly on smartphones, tablets, laptops, and TVs.
HomePage.benefit4Desc: Give kids a space of their own with content just for them.
HomePage.faq1A: Netflix is a streaming service that offers a wide variety of award-winning TV shows, movies, anime, documentaries, and more.
HomePage.faq2A: Netflix offers a range of pricing plans to suit your needs. Choose the plan that's right for you.
HomePage.faq3A: Watch anywhere, anytime, on an unlimited number of devices. Sign in with your Netflix account to watch instantly on the web or on any internet-connected device.
HomePage.faq4A: Netflix is flexible. There are no annoying contracts and no commitments. You can easily cancel your account online in two clicks.
HomePage.faq5A: Netflix Kids experience gives parents control while kids enjoy family-friendly TV shows and movies in their own space.
